deviations: src/sql/changes/MOD-008/Layercake.silv_data_anomaly.up.sql and .down.sql hold a no-op `ALTER TABLE Layercake.silv_data_anomaly CHECK CONSTRAINT ALL` from an earlier run on this branch. The answer of 2026-11-06 says no change script or dummy ALTER should exist, but my tools cannot delete files, and write_table_change will not take an empty script. I asked the owner to delete both files; the answer was deferred. Assumption: they stay until a human removes them. They change no structure, and the round-trip passes with them.

usp_load_silv_data_anomaly_segment updates detail on a case that is still raised when the text has changed, for example when the contact-year's segment invoice is a different invoice. It compares bytes and leaves first_detected_at and last_seen_at as they were, and the change is counted in rows_updated. The design says cases that still apply are left untouched. That holds whenever the data has not changed, so a rerun still logs 0, 0, 0 (TC-008-013). I chose this so that detail always names the current segment invoice.
notes:
MOD-008 delivers Layercake.usp_load_silv_data_anomaly_segment. For contact-years from 2022 with a live segment invoice, it reconciles CORPORATE_FLAG_NO_SCHEME, DOUBLE_PAYMENT, CONCESSION_NOT_IN_REFERENCE (one row per unknown item code) and FULL_CONCESSION_NO_CONCESSION. New cases are inserted, cases that no longer apply are deleted, and rows of other anomaly types are never touched. anomaly_nk is '<type>:<contact_no>:<campaign_year>[:<item_code>]'. detail names the Campaign Year and the segment invoice (number and rec_id). A Full Concession year with no segment invoice raises nothing here: per the 2026-11-06 answer, that gap is MOD-011's EVENT_NO_INVOICE.

The module also changes the Phase 1 Layercake.usp_load_silv_data_anomaly, keeping its style and logic. The only change is that its resolve step now stamps resolved_at only on open rows of its own eleven Phase 1 types (ELECTION_NO_ENROLMENT, ELECTION_BEFORE_ENROLMENT, RPQ_WITH_ENROLMENT, STALE_LAPSE_IGNORED, NO_RICS_RECORD, NO_TRANSACTIONS, JOIN_NO_PAYMENT, ENROLMENT_AFTER_FIRST_PAID, ELECTION_AFTER_FIRST_PAID, ENROLMENT_BEFORE_FIRST_PAID, ELECTION_BEFORE_FIRST_PAID). The down script restores the Phase 1 definition. The silv_data_anomaly table file is unchanged.

A new unit test checks that the Phase 1 load resolves its own open rows and leaves segment and invoice types open. No grants are needed.

Starting point: the Tester's suite already passed on this branch from earlier work. The remaining changes were the Phase 1 procedure scoping and its unit test. Final run: 26 of 26 Tester tests and 7 developer tests pass. Round-trip and checks pass; the sqlfluff findings are advisory.

Test-first: the first run had 26 of 26 of the Tester's tests passing; the final run passed 26 of 26 and 7 unit test(s), in 3 run(s).
